entries.10d9dc601aaedd5b: Aiming to become a comprehensive logistics services business centered on the transport business, its mission is to contribute broadly to local communities and to the public welfare. Centered on its core less-than-truckload (LTL) freight service, it works to improve logistics efficiency and transport quality through its network of bases, and to build a transport system that responds to diversifying demand. In addition, it actively proposes higher value-added logistics forms such as 3PL, and by strengthening its warehousing business and expanding reverse logistics, it works to be trusted as a partner to customers by responding to a wide range of needs. For logistics efficiency, it works on improving loading rates through IT, diversifying transport modes including the use of JR containers, and expanding joint collection and delivery.
entries.16c666705e96a224: Headquartered in Okayama, it has principal branch offices and branches in Tokyo, Nagoya, Osaka, Hyogo, Okayama, Tsuyama, Kurashiki, Hiroshima, Fukuyama, Yonago, Shikoku, Fukuoka and other locations, and its foundation is a network that carries freight from the Kanto region to Kyushu. Since its founding in 1943, it has gradually expanded its route business and has also broadened its handled operations to include warehousing, rail freight forwarding, air cargo and customs clearance. Its common name is Okaken.
entries.1a28363ef2c4ed33: Its head office is in Kita-ku, Okayama City, and it forms a corporate group with 9 subsidiaries and 2 affiliates. Consolidated employees numbered 2,173 as of March 31, 2026.

entries.7346bba701bc559d: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company is described as having worked to secure volume and improve performance, including pursuing active sales to expand transactions and negotiate freight and fee revisions for sustainable growth, and carrying out base consolidation and joint delivery with other companies in the same industry. In freight transport-related business, operating revenue increased through continued efforts to secure volume and collect appropriate freight and fees.

entries.7c852afc84d54817: It has two reportable segments, freight transport-related and petroleum product sales, and also an “other” category that is not included in the reportable segments. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, operating revenue from external customers was ¥36,896 million for freight transport-related, ¥1,011 million for petroleum product sales and ¥991 million for other. By region, the Chugoku region is largest at ¥20,079 million, and all operations are conducted in Japan. Information by major customer is omitted because no single customer accounts for 10% or more of consolidated operating revenue.

entries.9c278748bbc88de4: This is a reportable segment that is the core business of the group. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥36,896 million. The company and its subsidiaries, including Okayamaken Kamotsu Kōun Co., Ltd., develop transport quality responsive to market needs and provide a wide range of services, and Marukē Jidōsha Seibi Co., Ltd. is in charge of the automobile repair division. Affiliate Okayamaken Torakku Tāminaru Co., Ltd. operates the truck terminal business, and Sanyō Container Transport Co., Ltd. operates the freight forwarding business. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 2,131.
